claim.natural: The least n such that every red-blue edge-colouring of K_n contains two vertex-disjoint monochromatic copies of K_4 is 20; the copies need not have the same colour.

limitations: The dependency establishes unsatisfiability only for the two exact pinned fixed-core CNFs.
The upper bound reuses this dependency rather than independently reproducing it.
The graph-theoretic reduction and graph-to-CNF equivalence remain separate, unaudited proof obligations.
Dependency closure is repository-reported as unknown.
dependencies.statement: For each of the two order-16 (4,4)-Ramsey cores used in the pinned z(20) release, the exact fixed-core CNF over the 64 cross edges is unsatisfiable.

downstream.statement: The claim may be cited only as an unrefereed candidate determination, not as an established theorem under the common policy. Any citation must state that the two copies may differ in colour; the lower construction is hand-checkable with a standard-library verifier; the upper bound reuses repository-reported, locally checked certificates for two exact fixed-core CNFs; the semantic graph-to-CNF bridge and dependency closure are incomplete; there is no complete human review, independent reproduction, end-to-end equivalence proof, end-to-end formalization, or complete objection search; and no extremal uniqueness or enumeration is claimed.

notes: UNKNOWN is a downstream-use decision under the supplied policy, not a global mathematical truth verdict. All positive assessments are unauthenticated repository self-reports, and the ClaimPack evidence records are reference-only rather than embedded. The supplied release reports exact-CNF checking and a one-machine local replay, neither of which establishes independent reproduction or the complete graph-theoretic theorem.
